justifications.type_expressiveness: Good use of enums for Expr, BinOp, UnaryOp, Value, and EvalError variants, but TypeError carries a String message rather than a structured variant and ParseError similarly uses a free-form message string.
justifications.error_handling: Typed error enums with the three required distinguishing variants and no panics in library paths, but TypeError/ParseError lean on stringly-typed messages and there are no documented expect/unwrap rationales.
justifications.api_ergonomics: Public items lack doc comments (only a module-level comment exists), and manual Debug impls are provided where derives would suffice, though Display is correctly implemented and the surface is reasonably narrow.
justifications.idiomaticity: Generally idiomatic with ?, matches!, and recursive descent, but uses Vec<(&str, Value)> with clone-on-extend for the environment and a needless format! without arguments in parse_atom.
